name: S1Mode

test_list.description: An empty Decide batch is rejected at the RPC boundary before explicit model loading.
The S1 worker explicitly rejects service modes it does not implement.
The Shutdown handler signals transport shutdown before it waits for local drain, so handler cancellation cannot strand admission-closed service.
A pending transport graceful-shutdown future returns a deadline outcome after the configured grace interval.
Waiting for another drain operation consumes the same grace budget as inference shutdown and thread completion.

Ignored acceptance test launches a bounded worker subprocess with explicit local artifacts and a parent-issued stdin credential, exercises the public named-pipe S1Client connector and real model probabilities, then signals EOF shutdown.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Explicit local model directory, ONNX Runtime dynamic library, CPU provider, normalization policy, and private local transport endpoint.

output_description: An isolated S1 worker RPC service that loads and serves only explicitly configured local model artifacts.
